subject_need: Preserve and safely reuse multi-agent quality judgment over time.
alternative_solutions: Create a new standalone judgment-memory package.
Extend the existing QIF Living Ledger with judgment memory policy, entries, dependencies, revisions, retirement decisions, joins, and assessments.
non_solution_options: Store only the final consensus or agent transcript.
